description: Scrapes YouTube videos matching any keyword or search query using apidojo's YouTube scraper on Apify. Triggers when the user asks to: get YouTube videos for a keyword, scrape YouTube search results for a topic, export YouTube video data for a query, fetch video metadata for a YouTube search term, collect YouTube videos about a subject, or download YouTube video stats by keyword. Returns video title, channel name, view count, like count, comment count, duration, and publish date per video. Ideal for content researchers, SEO analysts, and market intelligence teams.
